text: The county courthouse holds public proceedings.
County roads are maintained with public funds.
The county sheriff's office employs sworn deputies.
The county fair is held once a year.
The county treasurer collects property taxes.
The county commission adopts an annual budget.
The county fair is held in outer space.
The county courthouse is a private residence.
County roads are paved with gold.
The county sheriff's office is a television studio.
The county commission meets on the moon.
